title: BlackLanturn 1.1.35
summary: Tracking providers are enabled as part of the update before completion is confirmed.

sections.heading: Tracking setup completes automatically
bullets: New bundled modules are registered and enabled before the update reports success.
Corrects the disabled Helper Trakt/MDbList modules introduced in1.1.34. Saved tracking choices and authorizations stay in place.

sections.heading: Preservation and recovery
bullets: Existing disabled user add-ons remain untouched. Later explicit provider disables remain saved.
Registration failures restore the previous code, release details and prior module enabled states; interrupted registration is recoverable.

sections.heading: Current add-ons and your complete setup
bullets: Retains Umbrella6.7.98, TMDb Helper6.19.2, UpNext1.3.0 and the reviewed BlackLanturn compatibility patches.
Use Update BlackLanturn to retain settings, accounts, sources, progress, unrelated add-ons and personal extensions.
